the two are incompatible because only one of them can be right about the range argument: if qi had a thousandfold range at the opening, no ore debt was ever necessary, and the ore ledger is then a later fiction with an old date on it.

they are incompatible about cause and not about fact: the same closed working face and the same absent spatial law read as a shortage on one side and as a reason a closure held on the other, so no observation settles it.

they are incompatible about direction only: a narrowed gene pool with a sustained-effort grant is the same fact read as something found or as something selected, which is why the dispute is settled by custody rather than by evidence.
they are incompatible about agency, and the only evidence that could separate them is a qi reading the frame itself cannot record, so the disagreement is structurally permanent.
the disagreement decides whether the six-group supply is closed by nature or curated by whoever could afford to remove a group, which is why both readings are taught and neither is filed.

they are incompatible about origin and the only fact that touches both is a jade reading no shore survey has ever matched, which favours the copy and is exactly what the body account exists to explain.
